searches.reason: Strong sampled training margins leave full-catalog failures unresolved. Find practical ways to measure candidate-sampling uncertainty, top-10 displacement and popularity-conditioned errors using the same trained GRU4Rec. Keep these descriptive diagnostics separate from the unchanged host validation metric.
searches.query: sequential recommendation sampled evaluation full catalog ranking disagreement negative sampling bias popularity stratified diagnostics uncertainty 2023 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Move beyond history sensitivity toward identifying model components responsible for forgetting or weak discrimination. Seek GRU gate, state-Jacobian and gradient-conflict probes with intervention-based sanity checks; apply them to one trained network without fitting auxiliary predictors or assuming that stronger recency improves accuracy.
searches.query: GRU recurrent recommender diagnostic probes gate saturation effective memory hidden state Jacobian gradient conflict attribution sanity checks 2023 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Translate the twenty users’ qualitative feedback into auditable evidence: distinguish choosing now, general relevance, explicit rejection and uncertain identity. Find annotation and reliability methods that link item-level feedback to full-catalog ranks, while treating compatibility, ownership and mood as unknown unless explicitly reported. Titles and descriptions can support textual connections, not establish suitability.
searches.query: recommender evaluation actionable relevance user feedback annotation rejection reasons uncertainty inter annotator reliability small sample recommendation explanations 2023 2024 2025 2026
